unlisted_practices: Design clinical risk prediction tools with minimal, clinically meaningful, readily available inputs to promote clinician adoption
Integrate risk calculators seamlessly into existing clinician workflows for efficiency and accessibility
Publish comparative performance data against existing clinical standards and external validations to build clinician trust

screen.reason: Qualitative interview study of 22 clinicians identifying factors influencing clinical adoption and implementation of clinical risk prediction scores (using VOCAL-Penn score as a case example).
